usage: cox runs fetch [-h] [--runs-dir RUNS_DIR] [--profile PROFILE] [--all] [run_id]

positional arguments:
  run_id

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --runs-dir RUNS_DIR  override: resolve the run's records here instead of the profile's
                       workspace_dir
  --profile PROFILE
  --all                fetch every remote run with no local tasks directory yet; a live run is
                       skipped
